Advance how our customers operate while you advance your career. Join GDIT as a Systems Engineer Senior and build an impactful career in enterprise IT, collaborating with people who are driven and resourceful like you.

  
  

Meaningful work and Personal Impact

  
  

As a Systems Engineer Senior, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission to provide sustaining engineering and product lifecycle management support for multiple Force Protection System (FPS) Family of Systems (FOS) to the IBD-SS II program.

  
  

You will play a crucial role in execute planning, design, and implementation of system engineering projects, by providing clear technical direction to team members and have breadth of knowledge as it pertains to systems integration and design.

  
  

The ability to work hand in hand with test engineers and technical writers in developing engineering test plans with the commanding knowledge of engineering processes, standards and workflows and will work closely with the Configuration Manager to ensure all system’s product baselines are maintained.

  
  

As the Sustainment Engineer you will be responsible forreviewing existing Urgent Capability Acquisition (UCA) programs and providing solutions to issues usually related to sustainment engineering, including investigating root causes of errors or failures, identifying alternatives for end-of-life components, and creating and maintaining documentation

  
  

Collaborate with IBD-SS team members from engineering, training, logistics, and operational support as well as government customers, to facilitate operational improvements and provide reach-back support to perform troubleshooting, maintenance, documentation distribution, sparing, and system health reports

  
  

Drive key outcomes by assisting in the analysis of failed products to improve sustainment support through viable solutions to include but not limited too

* Review baseline designs for errors and failure points.

* Execute Level of Repair Analysis for systems end to end.

* Develop Engineering BOMs from Technical Data Packages

* Attend Engineering Review Boards for engineering change requests and prepare documents for CCB

* Brief Engineering Change Proposals to CCB

* Development of engineering test plans and reports

* Address obsolescence issues and concerns working in conjunction with the IBD-SS logistics team

* Interface with other engineers, SMEs, and technicians to solve equipment malfunctions and design flaws

* Manage the full life cycle of systems with a focus on sustainment engineering.

* Support existing systems by researching, reviewing design, assisting procurement, cataloging, installing, and conducting maintenance of FP Systems.

Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Systems Engineer Senior must have:

* Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science (years of experience will be considered in lieu of a degree)

* Experience: 5+ years of related experience
* Security clearance level: US Secret security clearance required day one; required to maintain secret clearance to remain on contract

* Role requirements: This position is onsite 100% in Huntsville, AL, travel maybe required to support the mission up to 50% both CONUS and OCONUS contingent on mission requirements and could change based on customer requirements and the ability to support all other requirements based on the mission and the scope of the position
  

  

Specific tools, skills or technologies desired in this system engineering sustainment role include but are not limited to:

* QA/QC experience as it relates to Physical Configuration Audits

* Understanding of the full scope of the engineering lifecycle from concept to divestment

* Experience translating an Engineering BOM into a Service BOM for logistics

* Experience with DoD Systems, Engineering requirements and DoD contracts

* Superior technical writing skills, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Field Bulletins, Maintenance plan

* Experience preparing Engineering Change Proposals (ECP) and Technical Data Packages (TDP)

### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or London, UK (Hybrid)**

### **About the role**

You'll design and build the core infrastructure that powers AI inference across Cloudflare's global network — real-time voice, frontier open LLMs, and customer-deployed models running on a heterogeneous fleet of GPUs and next-generation accelerators in hundreds of cities worldwide. Working alongside AI/ML engineers, hardware partners, and Cloudflare product teams, you'll solve hard problems in distributed systems and high-performance computing: sub-second model cold starts, multi-accelerator workload scheduling, efficient KV cache management, and a model deployment platform serving both Cloudflare and customers bringing their own models.

We're building an AI inference platform embedded in the fabric of the internet — something that doesn't exist yet — and this role puts you at the center of it. We're looking for high-agency systems engineers who are energized by foundational infrastructure problems and want to define how AI runs at the edge of the network.

* **Platform Architecture:** Develop and maintain core components of the serverless inference platform to ensure high availability and scalability for Cloudflare users.

* **Technical Leadership:** Lead complex, cross-functional technical projects from initial concept and design through final deployment and operationalization.
* **Mentorship:** Act as a mentor to junior engineers and actively contribute to cultivating a strong, collaborative engineering culture within the team.

### **Desirable skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* Proven experience in systems engineering, with a primary focus on distributed, high-performance systems.
* Expert proficiency in **Rust** programming, particularly in an asynchronous environment.
* Deep understanding and hands-on experience with relevant networking and application protocols (e.g., TCP, HTTP, WebSocket).
* Solid experience with scaling and performance optimization techniques, including load balancing and caching in a distributed environment.

### **Bonus Points**

* Demonstrable experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically **Kubernetes** and/or **Nomad**.
* Familiarity with the unique architectural challenges involved in large-scale inference serving (e.g., LLMs and diffusion models).

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DEXMATE**

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the boundary where our robot's electronics meet its software. You will bring up and debug new PCBs, write the firmware and drivers that make every sensor, camera, actuator, and compute module talk to each other, and make sure data moves reliably across CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, GMSL, I2C, SPI, and Ethernet.

This is a hands-on, cross-layer role. One day you're probing a board with a scope to find why a bus is dropping frames; the next you're writing a Linux driver for a camera serializer or tuning an EtherCAT network for deterministic timing. You'll work closely with electrical, firmware, controls, and robotics software engineers, and you'll often be the person who figures out whether a problem lives in hardware, firmware, or software.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Bringing up, validating, and debugging new PCBs: reading schematics and layouts, measuring signals, and isolating hardware vs. software faults
* Developing firmware for MCUs (bare-metal and RTOS) and drivers for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson / Orin)
* Writing and maintaining device drivers and communication stacks for CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet
* Integrating camera and sensor pipelines over GMSL (serializer/deserializer configuration, device trees, V4L2 drivers, timing and synchronization)
* Bringing up and tuning EtherCAT and CAN networks across actuators, sensors, and power systems for deterministic, real-time performance
* Debugging signal-integrity, power, timing, and bus-level issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Contributing firmware and software input during schematic and PCB design reviews to make boards easier to bring up, test, and debug
* Building diagnostics, test fixtures, and automated hardware-in-the-loop tests for boards and subsystems
* Supporting manufacturing, end-of-line testing, and field troubleshooting as robots move from prototype to deployment
* Documenting interfaces, bring-up procedures, and debugging playbooks for the wider team

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of professional experience in embedded systems in robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or complex consumer electronics
* Strong C and C++ skills for firmware and driver development; working knowledge of Python for tooling and test automation
* Hands-on board bring-up experience, including reading schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and timing diagrams
* Driver-level experience with several of: CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet
* Experience with MCU firmware (ARM Cortex-M, STM32, TI C2000, or similar) on bare-metal or RTOS platforms
* Comfort with embedded debugging and lab tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Systematic debugging skills across the hardware, firmware, and software boundary
* Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with electrical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with GMSL or other high-speed camera links (e.g., MAX9295/MAX9296, FPD-Link), MIPI CSI-2, and V4L2
* Embedded Linux kernel and device-driver development, device trees, and BSP bring-up (NVIDIA Jetson / Orin a plus)
* Experience integrating EtherCAT master or slave stacks (SOEM, IgH, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCad) and the ability to propose schematic-level fixes
* Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and EMC fundamentals
* Experience with motor-control, BMS, or power-electronics systems
* Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware
* Prior experience working in a vertically integrated robotics or hardware startup
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation

Compensation Range: $100K - $300K

jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK**

### **About the Role**

Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
* Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
* Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
* Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
* Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
* Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
* You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
* You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
* You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
* You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
* You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

### **Bonus Points**

* You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
* Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
* You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
* You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

### **Compensation**

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

* For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

* Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.

* Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.

Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) for querying and analyzing test results at scale.  
  
Experience automating physical devices in a test lab, including multi-device or hardware-in-the-loop setups.  
  
Experience owning quality for new products or features during early development and platform bring-up.  
  
Familiarity with Apple developer tools such as Xcode, Instruments, and xcodebuild.  
  
Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and data visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Tableau) for tracking automation health and reporting quality trends.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Strong computer science fundamentals, including object-oriented design. A specific degree or concentration is not required.  
  
Proficiency in Python or Swift, with experience writing maintainable test automation or tooling, and a willingness to learn.  
  
Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., XCTest, XCUITest, pytest) and CI/CD systems.  
  
Proven ability to triage failures and find the root cause of complex issues across software, devices, and infrastructure, using logs, crash reports, and debugging tools.  
  
Clear written and verbal communication, including turning technical findings into actionable bug reports and concise summaries for engineers and leadership.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.  
  
  

### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure
* Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals
* Contribute directly to technical work including architecture reviews, design documents, and hands-on coding to maintain credibility and unblock the team
* Identify and resolve systemic issues affecting team velocity, including on-call load, technical debt, and gaps in tooling or automation
* Partner with product, design, and data science to ensure engineers contribute across disciplines and deliver outcomes that move business metrics forward

* Communicate team goals, technical decisions, and progress clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, including written design proposals and postmortems
* Participate in org-wide engineering contributions, sharing effective workflows, tooling practices, and systems engineering patterns across the broader organization

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on systems-level software, platform infrastructure, or distributed systems
* 2+ years of experience managing or leading engineering teams, including setting technical direction and supporting engineer growth
* Experience driving technical roadmaps and executing against them with measurable outcomes in ambiguous or high-complexity environments
* Experience identifying and resolving engineering efficiency issues such as on-call burden, technical debt, or gaps in automation
* Experience collaborating across product, design, and data functions to deliver software that achieves business and user impact

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of hands-on technical contribution as a manager, including authoring design documents, reviewing system architectures, or writing production code
* Experience with hardware/software co-design cycles: collaborating with silicon architects, validating architectural features with real kernels, and influencing hardware roadmaps based on software performance analysis
* Experience working on customized AI accelerators (TPU, AI ASICs, or similar non-GPU architectures) with direct involvement in kernel development and roofline enablement
* Familiarity with transformer and attention kernel design: FlashAttention-class algorithms, KV-cache management, paged and chunked attention, MoE routing and expert dispatch
* Experience with distributed execution and collective communication (NCCL/RCCL-class primitives, tensor and expert parallelism, overlapping communication with compute)

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
* You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
* You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 4+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
* 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**The Role**

The Manufacturing Automation Engineer – Cobots leads the development, deployment, optimization, and sustainment of manufacturing automation solutions across GPS manufacturing sites. This role combines deep manufacturing engineering expertise with end-to-end project leadership.

  

You will identify processes suitable for automation, evaluate the right solution—including collaborative robots (cobots), traditional industrial robots, vision systems, controls, and other automation technologies—and lead turnkey projects from concept through launch and sustainment. You will partner with plant teams, manufacturing engineering, controls and automation teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve safety, quality, ergonomics, throughput, labor efficiency, equipment utilization, and cost performance.

  

This role supports projects across multiple plant locations. Travel may exceed 50% during critical launch periods.

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer, Hardware Architecture
jobs.description:
Meta Reality Labs is seeking a principal-level AI Systems Engineer to define the hardware architecture strategy for next-generation AI-accelerated computing systems powering virtual and augmented reality products. In this role, you will shape the long-term silicon and systems roadmap for on-device AI inference and training workloads across wearables, headsets, and spatial computing platforms. A core focus of this role is driving the architecture of advanced imaging systems and camera pipelines that enable real-time perception, scene understanding, and mixed reality experiences. You will drive architectural decisions that span custom silicon, memory subsystems, interconnects, image signal processors (ISPs), camera subsystems, and software-hardware co-design, ensuring Meta's AI hardware remains at the forefront of performance, efficiency, and capability for immersive computing experiences.  
  
  

### **AI Systems Engineer, Hardware Architecture Responsibilities:**

* Define multi-generation hardware architecture strategy for AI inference and training systems across VR, AR, and wearable device platforms
* Lead system-level architectural exploration and trade-off analysis across compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect fabric, and power delivery for on-device AI workloads
* Architect end-to-end camera and imaging pipelines, including sensor interfaces, ISP integration, and real-time image processing for computer vision and perception applications
* Drive hardware-software co-design initiatives by partnering with silicon engineering, firmware, camera systems, and ML platform teams to optimize end-to-end AI and imaging pipeline performance
* Define architectural requirements for camera subsystems including multi-camera synchronization, depth sensing, and low-latency visual processing for AR/VR applications
* Establish architectural requirements and performance targets for custom AI accelerators, ISPs, SoCs, and supporting subsystems in spatial computing devices
* Develop and maintain system performance models and simulation frameworks to evaluate architectural decisions against real-world AI and imaging workload characteristics
* Provide architectural guidance and technical direction across hardware engineering organizations, aligning imaging and AI roadmaps with product and research priorities
* Identify and resolve system-level bottlenecks in imaging latency, AI inference throughput, and energy efficiency for wearable and headset form factors
* Engage with external silicon partners, camera module vendors, and research institutions to evaluate emerging imaging technologies and incorporate them into long-range architecture plans
* Communicate architectural vision and technical rationale to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders through written proposals and design reviews

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in hardware systems architecture, with a focus on AI, ML, imaging systems, or high-performance compute systems
* Deep expertise in camera pipeline architecture, including image signal processing (ISP), sensor integration, and end-to-end imaging system design
* Experience defining SoC or system-level architecture for AI inference or training workloads, including memory subsystem design, compute hierarchy, and interconnect topology
* Experience architecting imaging subsystems for real-time computer vision applications, including multi-camera systems, depth sensing, and visual-inertial odometry
* Experience developing system performance models and using simulation or analytical frameworks to evaluate architectural trade-offs at scale
* Track record of driving multi-year hardware architecture roadmaps for imaging and AI systems and influencing silicon strategy across large engineering organizations

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with custom silicon development flows for imaging and AI accelerators, including architecture-to-RTL handoff, physical design constraints, and post-silicon validation
* Experience architecting AI and imaging systems for power- and area-constrained wearable or mobile devices, including VR headsets, AR glasses, or similar spatial computing platforms
* Expertise in computational photography pipelines, HDR processing, and neural ISP architectures
* Background in collaborating with ML research and camera teams to translate novel imaging algorithms and model architectures into hardware-efficient deployment targets
* Experience evaluating and integrating emerging memory technologies (e.g., HBM, LPDDR5X, in-memory compute) into AI and imaging system architectures

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. ### **About the Role**

Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
* Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
* Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
* Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
* Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
* Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
* You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
* You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
* You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
* You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
* You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

### **Bonus Points**

* You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
* Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
* You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
* You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.

**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon and Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. We’re a growing team of diverse, talented & passionate engineers inventing and delivering technology to light up the “world’s computer!” We are working on the next generation hardware/firmware for server, silicon and rack infrastructure with a focus on innovation in firmware technology to secure Azure infrastructure for Microsoft and their customers. We believe that a robust firmware infrastructure leads to incredibly powerful computing experiences—if you believe this too, we need you!

Microsoft's first-party (1P) Firmware team is seeking a **Senior Firmware & System Debug Engineer** for future MAIA and Cobalt products from silicon bring-up through production fleet operation. * Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, prototype, and evaluate results
* Participate in peer reviews, identify, track and repair defects

* Active US Secret Clearance required
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and a minimum of 2 years experience in computer/software engineering field, or a Graduate degree with 0-2 years of related experience or, in lieu of a degree, 6 years of related experience.

* Experience with Modern C++, C#
* Experience with Python and bash

We're seeking a talented Senior AI/ML Engineer to build and scale the intelligent systems behind Apple's globally led creative marketing team. * Communicate technical issues early, work effectively in changing schedules and test conditions, and help drive actions through resolution.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.  
  
  

### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure
* Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals
* Contribute directly to technical work including architecture reviews, design documents, and hands-on coding to maintain credibility and unblock the team
* Identify and resolve systemic issues affecting team velocity, including on-call load, technical debt, and gaps in tooling or automation

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on systems-level software, platform infrastructure, or distributed systems
* 2+ years of experience managing or leading engineering teams, including setting technical direction and supporting engineer growth
* Experience driving technical roadmaps and executing against them with measurable outcomes in ambiguous or high-complexity environments
* Experience identifying and resolving engineering efficiency issues such as on-call burden, technical debt, or gaps in automation
* Experience collaborating across product, design, and data functions to deliver software that achieves business and user impact

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of hands-on technical contribution as a manager, including authoring design documents, reviewing system architectures, or writing production code
* Experience with hardware/software co-design cycles: collaborating with silicon architects, validating architectural features with real kernels, and influencing hardware roadmaps based on software performance analysis

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is seeking a **Principal Systems Engineer** to support fielded airborne ISR systems and associated data center, network, and communication infrastructures at Beale AFB, CA. This role is a key technical interface between operations, field users, engineering Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), and customer representatives. The selected engineer will apply systems thinking to sustain and improve mission systems, resolve complex field issues, and drive configuration changes from concept through implementation in support of 24/7 operations.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the on-site systems engineering liaison between operations, engineering IPTs, and customer stakeholders to resolve field issues, escalations, and installations.
* Sustain and provide real-time support for mission systems, including operating systems (Windows, Linux, VMware ESXi), data center hardware (compute, storage, network), and ground communication/network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, SATCOM/RF).
* Perform system-level troubleshooting and root cause analysis across avionics, data center, network, and communication subsystems in field and control room environments.
* Plan, configure, integrate, and test hardware/software changes in lab and operational environments; ensure interoperability across compute, storage, and network.
* Lead intake, technical review, and execution of configuration and change requests, including preparation of Configuration Change Board (CCB) packages with risk assessments and implementation guidance.
* Coordinate and track cross-functional action items and change requests; maintain status and performance metrics for field modifications and fixes.
* Develop and execute test plans, integration procedures, and verification/validation activities for new or modified payloads, instrumentation, and network configurations.
* Provide technical briefings and written status updates to customers, program leadership, and internal stakeholders.
* Support mission operations, including shift work, weekends, holidays, and occasional overtime.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s of Science Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 5 years of related systems engineering or related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related systems engineering or related engineering experience
* Experience with system integration, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across hardware, software, and network boundaries.
* Familiarity with modern operating systems and networking concepts (e.g., Windows and/or Linux administration, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, ACLs, VPNs).
* Experience reading and interpreting electrical and/or mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams and technicians to implement system changes and resolve issues under schedule pressure.
* Active USG Top Secret SCI clearance (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
* Ability to obtain and maintain initial Special Access Program (SAP) access via a Program Access Request (PAR). This SAP/PAR must be obtained prior to commencement of employment and must be obtained within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
* Ability to work non-standard hours (shift work, nights, weekends, holidays) and support occasional travel (up to ~25%).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear technical documentation and briefings.
* Experience supporting airborne ISR platforms and associated ground systems in field or test environments.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting network equipment (e.g., Cisco or equivalent switches/routers, firewalls such as Cisco ASA/Firepower or Palo Alto) and virtualized environments (VMware ESXi or similar).
* Familiarity with network management and security protocols (e.g., SNMP, SSH, syslog, RADIUS/TACACS).
* Experience with Agile practices and/or tools (e.g., JIRA) for managing engineering actions.
* Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., C, C++, Python, Bash)
* Prior military, flight test, or depot-level field engineering support experience.
* DoD 8140 IAT Level II (or higher) compliant certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CCNP, CISSP) strongly preferred.

At BAE Systems, we deliver a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. The Product Focal Lead (PFL) is responsible for managing production and field issues related to commercial avionics products. In this capacity, the PFL is responsible for communicating and managing issues with the customer (aircraft OEM) (10% of effort), BAE Systems operations team (10% of effort), and internally within the program team (10% of effort); lead the engineering team to investigate and resolve product issues, including leading the Engineering 7-Step investigation process (40% of effort), and perform direct engineering analysis of product issues (30% of effort).
